from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486032/attempts/84bcef3cf5a14479a7d0101da055aebf/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4d19888a.py')
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 8]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [[8 if grid[r][c] == 8 else 0 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
    copies = sum(value == 4 for row in grid for value in row)
    return [row * copies for row in shape]
''')
exec(compile(p.read_text(),str(p),'exec'),globals())
